content: {"paper_id":"W2591132901","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"partial-label-learning","exact_quote":"superset label learning (SLL) refers to the problem that a training example can be associated with a set of candidate labels, and only one of them is correct.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"SLL设定为每个实例对应候选标签集合且仅一个标签正确，属于偏标记学习。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"a training example can be associated with a set of candidate labels, and only one of them is correct.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"候选标签集提供不精确的实例级监督，且该监督条件是论文的实质研究问题。"},{"keyword_id":"graph-manifold-regularization","exact_quote":"we employ a graph to represent the training set, and require the examples that are adjacent on the graph to obtain similar labels.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"用图表示训练集并要求图上相邻样例获得相似标签，属于图结构几何一致性正则化。"},{"keyword_id":"label-correlation-modeling","exact_quote":"the intrinsic constraints among different candidate labels are deployed","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"明确部署不同候选标签间的内在约束，显式建模标签间互斥或依赖关系。"}],"abstentions":[{"keyword_id":"pseudo-label-self-training","reason_zh":"摘要仅提到从候选标签中判别真实标签，未说明将模型预测作为后续训练信号或迭代自训练。"}],"input_issues":[]}
